# Math Sprint Game

> A fast-paced educational web game where players race against time to solve
> math equations, testing speed and accuracy.

Author: Ashwini Jaiswal
Co-author: Sharmishtha Khairmode
Institution: Terna Engineering College, University of Mumbai
Programme: B.E. Computer Engineering, Fourth Year, Semester VIII
